description: Source code for Nordic Semiconductor nRF53 series RTC synchronization using Zephyr RTOS, involving IPC, PPI, and RTC hardware channels, with functions for setting up, handling callbacks, and managing synchronization process.

methods.name: ppi_ipc_to_rtc
methods.description: Sets up or clears the connection from IPC_RECEIVE to RTC_CAPTURE using PPI and IPC channels.

methods.name: ppi_rtc_to_ipc
methods.description: Sets up or clears the connection from RTC_COMPARE to IPC_SEND using PPI and IPC channels.

methods.name: free_resources
methods.description: Disables channels and frees resources associated with RTC and DPPI channels.

methods.name: z_nrf_rtc_timer_nrf53net_offset_get
methods.description: Returns the current RTC offset for nRF5340 network core, or -ENOSYS if not supported.

methods.name: rtc_cb
methods.description: RTC callback invoked on compare event to handle synchronization steps.

methods.name: sync_rtc_timestamp_get
methods.description: Returns the current system timestamp adjusted by the RTC offset.

methods.name: remote_callback
methods.description: Handles IPC event, updates RTC offset, and manages synchronization process.

methods.name: mbox_callback
methods.description: Handles mailbox message and triggers remote_callback.

methods.name: mbox_rx_init
methods.description: Initializes mailbox reception for synchronization messages.

methods.name: sync_rtc_setup
methods.description: Sets up RTC synchronization channels, IPC, PPI, and mailbox, and initiates synchronization.
